problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to load onto a cargo plane. Available packages are:
* Package 1: weight 45kg, revenue $64
* Package 2: weight 18kg, revenue $53
* Package 3: weight 22kg, revenue $245

* Package 14: weight 39kg, revenue $134
* Package 15: weight 25kg, revenue $128
* Package 16: weight 17kg, revenue $36
* Package 17: weight 1kg, revenue $186
* Package 18: weight 35kg, revenue $300
* Package 19: weight 44kg, revenue $147
* Package 20: weight 21kg, revenue $25
* Package 21: weight 33kg, revenue $10
* Package 22: weight 37kg, revenue $208
* Package 23: weight 16kg, revenue $245
* Package 24: weight 44kg, revenue $257
* Package 25: weight 19kg, revenue $74
* Package 26: weight 25kg, revenue $23
* Package 27: weight 14kg, revenue $126
* Package 28: weight 28kg, revenue $43
* Package 29: weight 6kg, revenue $169

The aircraft has a maximum cargo capacity of 459 kg. Select the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
